quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الٓمٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى رَفَعَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍۢ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّكُمْ تُوقِنُونَ

وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَدَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنْهَٰرًۭا ۖ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ جَعَلَ فِيهَا زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ ۖ يُغْشِى ٱلَّيْلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قِطَعٌۭ مُّتَجَٰوِرَٰتٌۭ وَجَنَّٰتٌۭ مِّنْ أَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَزَرْعٌۭ وَنَخِيلٌۭ صِنْوَانٌۭ وَغَيْرُ صِنْوَانٍۢ يُسْقَىٰ بِمَآءٍۢ وَٰحِدٍۢ وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعْضَهَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فِى ٱلْأُكُلِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

۞ وَإِن تَعْجَبْ فَعَجَبٌۭ قَوْلُهُمْ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍ ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَغْلَٰلُ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِمُ ٱلْمَثُلَٰتُ ۗ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍۢ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلْمِهِمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ
ٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنثَىٰ وَمَا تَغِيضُ ٱلْأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ ۖ وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِندَهُۥ بِمِقْدَارٍ
عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ٱلْمُتَعَالِ
سَوَآءٌۭ مِّنكُم مَّنْ أَسَرَّ ٱلْقَوْلَ وَمَن جَهَرَ بِهِۦ وَمَنْ هُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍۭ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَسَارِبٌۢ بِٱلنَّهَارِ

لَهُۥ مُعَقِّبَٰتٌۭ مِّنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ يَحْفَظُونَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا۟ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ۗ وَإِذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍۢ سُوٓءًۭا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَالٍ
هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَيُنشِئُ ٱلسَّحَابَ ٱلثِّقَالَ
وَيُسَبِّحُ ٱلرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِۦ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُمْ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْمِحَالِ

لَهُۥ دَعْوَةُ ٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُونَ لَهُم بِشَىْءٍ إِلَّا كَبَٰسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ إِلَى ٱلْمَآءِ لِيَبْلُغَ فَاهُ وَمَا هُوَ بِبَٰلِغِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا دُعَآءُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ
وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًۭا وَكَرْهًۭا وَظِلَٰلُهُم بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْءَاصَالِ ۩

قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًۭا وَلَا ضَرًّۭا ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ أَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَٱلنُّورُ ۗ أَمْ جَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ خَلَقُوا۟ كَخَلْقِهِۦ فَتَشَٰبَهَ ٱلْخَلْقُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّٰرُ

أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌۢ بِقَدَرِهَا فَٱحْتَمَلَ ٱلسَّيْلُ زَبَدًۭا رَّابِيًۭا ۚ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلنَّارِ ٱبْتِغَآءَ حِلْيَةٍ أَوْ مَتَٰعٍۢ زَبَدٌۭ مِّثْلُهُۥ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَٱلْبَٰطِلَ ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلزَّبَدُ فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَآءًۭ ۖ وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ فَيَمْكُثُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ

لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُۥ لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْحِسَابِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
۞ أَفَمَن يَعْلَمُ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلْحَقُّ كَمَنْ هُوَ أَعْمَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
ٱلَّذِينَ يُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَنقُضُونَ ٱلْمِيثَٰقَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ وَيَخَافُونَ سُوٓءَ ٱلْحِسَابِ

وَٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن كُلِّ بَابٍۢ
سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ

وَٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۙ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ
ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ وَفَرِحُوا۟ بِٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَٰعٌۭ
وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَنْ أَنَابَ
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَـَٔابٍۢ

كَذَٰلِكَ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ فِىٓ أُمَّةٍۢ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهَآ أُمَمٌۭ لِّتَتْلُوَا۟ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ قُلْ هُوَ رَبِّى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ

وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْءَانًۭا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ ٱلْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًۭا ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُوا۟ قَارِعَةٌ أَوْ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبًۭا مِّن دَارِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ وَعْدُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۗ وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ قُلْ سَمُّوهُمْ ۚ أَمْ تُنَبِّـُٔونَهُۥ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَم بِظَٰهِرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ ۗ بَلْ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مَكْرُهُمْ وَصُدُّوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۢ
لَّهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَشَقُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍۢ
۞ مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ أُكُلُهَا دَآئِمٌۭ وَظِلُّهَا ۚ تِلْكَ عُقْبَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ ۖ وَّعُقْبَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ ٱلنَّارُ

وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ مَن يُنكِرُ بَعْضَهُۥ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ وَلَآ أُشْرِكَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ إِلَيْهِ أَدْعُوا۟ وَإِلَيْهِ مَـَٔابِ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ حُكْمًا عَرَبِيًّۭا ۚ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَآءَهُم بَعْدَمَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا وَاقٍۢ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًۭا مِّن قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا وَذُرِّيَّةًۭ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍۢ كِتَابٌۭ
يَمْحُوا۟ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثْبِتُ ۖ وَعِندَهُۥٓ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ
وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ وَعَلَيْنَا ٱلْحِسَابُ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكْمِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
وَقَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَكْرُ جَمِيعًۭا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلْكُفَّٰرُ لِمَنْ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَسْتَ مُرْسَلًۭا ۚ قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ

parent_channels.name: P1 - Raised Frame and Scheduled Motion

subchannels.name: Elevated Canopy and Supports
subchannels.scene_or_process: A roof-like upper structure is raised, propped, and made the frame of rule.
subchannels.active_motifs: raised body or building (`quranic:root_000582:B001/m01`); support placed beneath a structure (`quranic:root_001043:B002/m01`); column or mainstay (`quranic:root_001043:B003/m01`); raised roof or canopy (`quranic:root_001000:B002/m01`); sky as what rises and overshadows (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:2 `رَفَعَ` (ر ف ع), `عَمَد` (ع م د), `العَرْش` (ع ر ش), and `السَّمَاوَات` (س م و).
subchannels.synthesis: Raising, supporting, roofing, and overshadowing form one construction scene. The unseen columns do not empty the image of material force; they make support itself the latent invariant beneath the visible heaven.

subchannels.name: Celestial Course and Appointment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Luminous bodies travel along a continuing course until a fixed endpoint.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing motion of sun and other bodies (`quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`); sun and its light (`quranic:root_000818:B001/m01`); moon and its light (`quranic:root_001255:B001/m01`); appointed temporal limit (`quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`); reflective ordering by the outcome of an affair (`quranic:root_000458:B006/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:2 `يَجْرِي` (ج ر ي), `الشَّمْس` (ش م س), `القَمَر` (ق م ر), `أَجَل` (ء ج ل), and `يُدَبِّرُ` (د ب ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The course is not motion alone: sun and moon move toward an appointment under administration that already regards the end. Time is pictured as a traversable, governed route.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A stable elevated frame orders movement beneath and within it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:2 raises the heavens (`رَفَعَ`, `السَّمَاوَات`) without visible columns (`عَمَد`), establishes the throne (`العَرْش`), and assigns the sun and moon (`الشَّمْس`, `القَمَر`) a measured course (`يَجْرِي`, `أَجَل`).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The cosmic order materializes as both load-bearing architecture and a timed itinerary.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Water Gathered, Routed, and Made Fruitful

subchannels.name: Catchments, Wells, and Hidden Sinks
subchannels.scene_or_process: Depressions and built holding places catch water before release.
subchannels.active_motifs: reservoir collecting well, channel, or rain water (`quranic:root_000016:B007/m01`); hollow retaining water for days (`quranic:root_000018:B006/m01`); rock hollow or newly cut well (`quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`); hidden low sink where water gathers (`quranic:root_001120:B002/m01`); timbered wellhead and station of the water drawer (`quranic:root_001000:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Basin, hollow, sink, and wellhead form a complete capture scene. These latent containers give material depth to the measured waters later released across the land.

subchannels.name: Channels, Valleys, and Outlets
subchannels.scene_or_process: Stored or descending water enters channels, seeps through terrain, and exits through mouths and valleys.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing river cut through earth (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`); water seeping and dripping (`quranic:root_000691:B003/m01`); running flood (`quranic:root_000770:B001/m01`); valley as flood-course (`quranic:root_001637:B005/m01`); watercourse fed by another body of water (`quranic:root_001407:B003/m01`); mouth or outlet of river and valley (`quranic:root_001190:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:3 `أَنْهَار` (ن ه ر) and `مَدَّ` (م د د); 13:10 `سَارِب` (س ر ب); 13:14 `فَاهُ` (ف و ه); 13:17 `سَالَت`/`السَّيْل` (س ي ل) and `أَوْدِيَة` (و د ي).
subchannels.synthesis: The branches assemble a hydraulic route from feeding current to channel, seepage, outlet, valley, and flood. The surface valley image therefore belongs to a wider mechanism of controlled passage rather than an isolated body of water.

subchannels.name: Irrigated Plot and Differentiated Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is apportioned to planted plots whose shared source produces distinct crops and fruit.
subchannels.active_motifs: irrigation share and channel (`quranic:root_000722:B003/m01`); sowing and cultivation (`quranic:root_000630:B001/m01`); ripened fruit (`quranic:root_000205:B001/m01`); crop and tree yield (`quranic:root_000043:B002/m01`); palms branching independently from one root (`quranic:root_000887:B002/m01`); palm tree (`quranic:root_001483:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:3 `الثَّمَرَات` (ث م ر); 13:4 `زَرْع` (ز ر ع), `يُسْقَى` (س ق ي), `الأُكُل` (ء ك ل), `صِنْوَان` (ص ن و), and `نَخِيل` (ن خ ل).
subchannels.synthesis: One water source enters an apportioned irrigation system, yet produces differentiated fruit, crops, and palm forms. Shared supply and varied output become one agricultural mechanism for materializing unity without sameness.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water becomes life-bearing when it is caught, directed, apportioned, and delivered to growth.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:3-4 place rivers, crops, vines, and palms in watered plots, while 13:17 sends water into valleys according to their capacity.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same hydrology extends backward into rock basins and hidden sinks and forward into managed irrigation.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Concealed Generation and Measured Increase

subchannels.name: Joining Counterparts
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maker joins one counterpart to another so that a productive pair is formed.
subchannels.active_motifs: paired counterpart joined to its mate (`quranic:root_000652:B001/m01`); adding one to one to make two (`quranic:root_000208:B001/m01`); female as counterpart to male (`quranic:root_000058:B001/m01`); making or bringing a thing into being (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:3 `جَعَلَ` (ج ع ل), `زَوْجَيْن` (ز و ج), and `اثْنَيْن` (ث ن ي); 13:8 `أُنْثَى` (ء ن ث).
subchannels.synthesis: Pairing is an operation rather than an umbrella category: a maker adds a second, joins counterparts, and establishes the condition from which fruit or offspring can arise.

subchannels.name: Womb, Burden, Loss, and Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concealed interior holds a developing burden whose diminution and increase remain measured.
subchannels.active_motifs: inward pregnancy or fruit-bearing (`quranic:root_000357:B002/m01`); womb as the offspring's growing chamber (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); diminution or retention (`quranic:root_001120:B001/m01`); increase and growth (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); bounded quantity and limit (`quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`); heaviness of a carried burden (`quranic:root_000202:B007/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:8 `تَحْمِلُ` (ح م ل), `الأَرْحَام` (ر ح م), `تَغِيضُ` (غ ي ض), `تَزْدَادُ` (ز ي د), and `مِقْدَار` (ق د ر); 13:12 `الثِّقَال` (ث ق ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Chamber, burden, decrease, increase, and exact limit form a gestational mechanism. The heavy cloud at 13:12 lexically echoes the carried burden without being folded into the womb scene itself.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Generation joins counterparts, conceals a burden, and regulates loss and growth until emergence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:3 pairs fruit, and 13:8 names the female, what wombs carry or lose, what increases, and the measure of every thing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Botanical pairing and human or animal gestation share one productive grammar without collapsing into the same scene.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Information Made Manifest and Answerable

subchannels.name: Concealed and Publicly Exposed
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hidden interior content is contrasted with witnessed and openly voiced content.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealment and secrecy (`quranic:root_000428:B001/m01`); keeping something inward and secret (`quranic:root_000697:B001/m01`); public declaration and raised voice (`quranic:root_000269:B001/m01`); presence with witnessing (`quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:9 `الشَّهَادَة` (ش ه د); 13:10 `أَسَرَّ` (س ر ر), `جَهَرَ` (ج ه ر), and `مُسْتَخْف` (خ ف ي).
subchannels.synthesis: Secrecy, hiddenness, public voicing, and witnessed presence form a disclosure contrast. The scene renders divine knowledge as access across both enclosed and exposed states.

subchannels.name: Articulation That Separates Meaning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech reaches its addressee by exposing and differentiating meaning.
subchannels.active_motifs: meaning disclosed by speech or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); detailed separation of parts and meanings (`quranic:root_001159:B013/m01`); utterance brought out in speech (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); eloquence that reaches the intended meaning (`quranic:root_000151:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Disclosure here is specifically linguistic: utterance is divided into intelligible parts, exposes its referent, and reaches an intended recipient. This gives the detailed signs a latent anatomy of articulate speech.

subchannels.name: Call, Warning, and Answer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A voice summons or warns, is carried outward, and seeks a replying voice.
subchannels.active_motifs: vocal summons drawing another toward something (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); spoken reply (`quranic:root_000273:B003/m01`); warning that awakens caution (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`); dispatch and outward sending (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:7 `مُنْذِر` (ن ذ ر); 13:13 `يُرْسِلُ` (ر س ل); 13:14 `دَعْوَة`/`يَدْعُون`/`دُعَاء` (د ع و) and `يَسْتَجِيبُون` (ج و ب); 13:18 `اسْتَجَابُوا`/`يَسْتَجِيبُوا` (ج و ب).
subchannels.synthesis: Sending, warning, calling, and answering form a complete communicative exchange. The unanswered invocation is therefore not mere silence but a broken response relation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is hidden becomes perceptible, articulate, transmitted, and open to response.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:9-10 contrast unseen and witnessed, secret and public speech, while 13:14 and 13:18 stage calling and response.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Visibility, articulate differentiation, warning, and answer behave as stages in one information flow.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Storm Force Announced and Delivered

subchannels.name: Cloud Build-Up and Electrical Strike
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloud mass rises and travels, flashes and sounds, then discharges a destructive strike.
subchannels.active_motifs: cloud rising into formation (`quranic:root_001502:B001/m01`); cloud drawn through the air (`quranic:root_000680:B002/m01`); heavy load (`quranic:root_000202:B007/m02`); lightning flash (`quranic:root_000108:B001/m01`); thunder of the sky (`quranic:root_000573:B003/m01`); thunderbolt as upper crash, fire, or death (`quranic:root_000864:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:12 `يُنْشِئُ` (ن ش ء), `السَّحَاب` (س ح ب), `الثِّقَال` (ث ق ل), and `البَرْق` (ب ر ق); 13:13 `الرَّعْد` (ر ع د) and `الصَّوَاعِق` (ص ع ق).
subchannels.synthesis: Formation, transport, burden, flash, report, and discharge make a single storm sequence. The cloud's heaviness becomes stored force whose release is both seen and heard.

subchannels.name: Menace, Targeting, and Punishment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Threat signs announce hostile force before a blow reaches its intended object.
subchannels.active_motifs: flashing and thundering as menace (`quranic:root_000108:B003/m01`); thunder-like verbal threat (`quranic:root_000573:B004/m01`); warning that induces caution (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`); aiming and reaching the target (`quranic:root_000889:B003/m01`); punishment following offense (`quranic:root_001033:B007/m01`); overwhelming strength and punitive mastery (`quranic:root_001402:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:6 `العِقَاب` (ع ق ب); 13:7 `مُنْذِر` (ن ذ ر); 13:12 `البَرْق` (ب ر ق); 13:13 `الرَّعْد` (ر ع د), `يُصِيبُ` (ص و ب), and `المِحَال` (م ح ل).
subchannels.synthesis: The storm's flash and thunder double as signs of menace, but the scene does not stop at rhetoric: targeting, impact, and punishment complete the causal sequence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Force gathers above, announces itself audibly and visibly, then reaches a selected target.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:12-13 build heavy clouds, lightning, thunder, and thunderbolts that strike whom God wills.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Meteorological signs and verbal menace share the same escalation from warning display to punitive impact.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Sovereign Custody and Alignment

subchannels.name: Throne, Dominion, and Administration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sovereign occupies the raised seat, owns the domain, and manages affairs toward their outcomes.
subchannels.active_motifs: lordship, mastery, and sovereignty (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); raised royal throne (`quranic:root_001000:B001/m01`); dominion and governing power (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); office and holder of authority (`quranic:root_000051:B003/m01`); administration by looking to consequences (`quranic:root_000458:B006/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:1-2 `رَبّ` (ر ب ب); 13:2 `العَرْش` (ع ر ش), `الأَمْر` (ء م ر), and `يُدَبِّرُ` (د ب ر); 13:13, 13:16 `مَلَائِكَة`/`يَمْلِكُون` (م ل ك).
subchannels.synthesis: Throne, dominion, office, and consequence-aware administration produce a specific court of rule. The surface ordering of creation is thereby reframed as active governance.

subchannels.name: Guarding and Standing Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: Custodians stand over a charge, watch it, and ward harm from it.
subchannels.active_motifs: guarding and entrusted care (`quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`); standing over something in care and governance (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); taking charge of an affair (`quranic:root_001684:B003/m01`); protecting hand and united support (`quranic:root_001693:B016/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Guard, standing custodian, governing protector, and supporting hand form a compact care scene around 13:11. Custody is delegated activity within sovereignty, not a second sovereign center.

subchannels.name: Voluntary and Compelled Submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodies lower themselves or are made tractable under command.
subchannels.active_motifs: prostration and lowering in submission (`quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`); making a thing tractable for a purpose (`quranic:root_000685:B001/m01`); willing obedience (`quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`); acting under aversion or compulsion (`quranic:root_001295:B002/m01`); hand given in surrender (`quranic:root_001693:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Tractability, willing obedience, coerced action, surrendered hand, and bodily lowering distinguish modes of alignment while preserving one relation of subjection.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Authority establishes order, delegates care, and draws subjects into willing or compelled alignment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:2 names throne and administration, 13:11 names guardianship, and 13:15 places all beings and their shadows in prostration.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Kingship, custodial care, and bodily submission are distinct scenes joined by ordered dependence.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Assay of Truth Through Foam and Fire

subchannels.name: Flood That Casts Off Surface Waste
subchannels.scene_or_process: Descending water becomes a flood, lifts froth, throws refuse aside, and leaves useful material in place.
subchannels.active_motifs: water delivered downward (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); water itself (`quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`); running flood (`quranic:root_000770:B001/m01`); floating froth (`quranic:root_000620:B001/m01`); refuse cast out by stream or pot (`quranic:root_000249:B001/m01`); staying with expectant persistence (`quranic:root_001437:B001/m01`); benefit as opposed to harm (`quranic:root_001536:B001/m01`); truth stable against falsehood (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); falsehood losing truth and stability (`quranic:root_000127:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:17 `أَنْزَلَ` (ن ز ل), `مَاء` (م و ه), `سَالَت`/`السَّيْل` (س ي ل), `زَبَد` (ز ب د), `جُفَاء` (ج ف ء), `يَمْكُثُ` (م ك ث), `يَنْفَعُ` (ن ف ع), `الحَقّ` (ح ق ق), and `البَاطِل` (ب ط ل).
subchannels.synthesis: The flood is a sorting operation: agitation raises light froth, current expels it, and useful matter remains. Truth is not merely compared with water; it is tested by persistence after turbulence.

subchannels.name: Furnace That Separates Metal From Dross
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fuel heats material until metal flows, ornament is sought, and froth-like dross rises away from the desired substance.
subchannels.active_motifs: kindling and combustion (`quranic:root_001672:B001/m01`); fuel feeding fire (`quranic:root_001672:B002/m01`); burning fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`); ornament worked from material (`quranic:root_000353:B001/m01`); gold as metal (`quranic:root_000522:B001/m01`); molten flow of iron (`quranic:root_000770:B003/m01`); metallic froth like that on silver (`quranic:root_000620:B001/m02`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:17 `يُوقِدُون` (و ق د), `النَّار` (ن و ر), `حِلْيَة` (ح ل ي), `يَذْهَبُ` (ذ ه ب), `سَالَت`/`السَّيْل` (س ي ل), and `زَبَد` (ز ب د).
subchannels.synthesis: Fire, fuel, molten flow, worked ornament, and dross form a full metallurgical assay. The latent gold and iron senses sharpen the surface analogy by making falsehood the waste exposed during refinement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A turbulent process brings superficial waste to the top while useful substance remains.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:17 explicitly parallels flood foam and smelting dross as a likeness of truth and falsehood.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Watercourse and furnace are separate material tests that disclose the same persistence invariant.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Seeing and Wayfinding

subchannels.name: Sight, Blindness, and Illumination
subchannels.scene_or_process: An eye either receives an illuminated field or loses access to it.
subchannels.active_motifs: sight by the eye (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); loss of sight (`quranic:root_001049:B001/m01`); seeing by eye or insight (`quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`); light and illumination (`quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:2, 13:12 `تَرَوْنَهَا`/`يُرِيكُم` (ر ء ي); 13:16 `البَصِير` (ب ص ر), `الأَعْمَى` (ع م ي), and `النُّور` (ن و ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Seeing, blindness, showing, and illumination form one perceptual scene. The contrast is not only epistemic; it is the difference between an available and unavailable visual field.

subchannels.name: Landmark and Guide
subchannels.scene_or_process: A marked feature stands out, indicates direction, and is followed by a guide.
subchannels.active_motifs: distinguishing mark or route marker (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); gentle indication of road and truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); visible waymark or beacon (`quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`); sign or appointed route marker (`quranic:root_000051:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Mark, beacon, and guide constitute a concrete navigation scene. Knowledge and illumination thus acquire the shape of route recognition rather than remaining abstract possession.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Perception becomes orientation when light, marks, and guidance disclose a traversable direction.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:7 names a guide, while 13:16 contrasts blind and seeing, darkness and light.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sight and guidance are joined through material landmarks rather than treated as generic cognition.

parent_channels.name: P1 - Bodily Restraint and Attempted Release

subchannels.name: Fettered Neck and Captive Body
subchannels.scene_or_process: A restraining device joins hand or body to the neck and holds a captive.
subchannels.active_motifs: iron or leather fetter around an organ (`quranic:root_001102:B006/m01`); neck as the place of collar or cord (`quranic:root_001053:B001/m01`); seizure and captivity (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); hand as the bodily member caught or bound (`quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:5 `الأَغْلَال` (غ ل ل) and `أَعْنَاق` (ع ن ق); 13:11 `يَدَيْه` (ي د ي); 13:16 `اتَّخَذْتُم` (ء خ ذ).
subchannels.synthesis: Fetter, neck, seized person, and caught hand make the punishment materially carceral. The chain is not decorative imagery but an apparatus that fixes the body.

subchannels.name: Ransom, Refuge, and Assigned Bed
subchannels.scene_or_process: A captive offers a substitute for release but instead receives a fixed refuge and bed.
subchannels.active_motifs: substitute paid to save a person (`quranic:root_001136:B001/m01`); ransom of a captive (`quranic:root_001136:B002/m01`); gathering into a place of refuge (`quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`); prepared bedding or resting ground (`quranic:root_001451:B002/m01`); reckoning and account (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:18 `افْتَدَوْا` (ف د ي), `الحِسَاب` (ح س ب), `مَأْوَى` (ء و ي), and `المِهَاد` (م ه د).
subchannels.synthesis: Ransom, attempted recovery of the captive, assigned refuge, and prepared bed form a failed-release scene. The bad account blocks substitution and fixes the final lodging.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A body is bound or captured, then release is sought through substitution or refuge.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:5 places fetters on necks, and 13:18 imagines an all-encompassing ransom before naming the final lodging.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Penal restraint and ransom form a juridical captivity scene across the interval.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Covenant as Tensioned Binding

subchannels.name: Fastened Pact
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agreement is tightened into a reliable bond that can hold parties or a captive.
subchannels.active_motifs: protected pact and sworn security (`quranic:root_001055:B003/m01`); structural firmness (`quranic:root_001623:B002/m01`); cord or restraint used to bind (`quranic:root_001623:B003/m01`); covenant confirmed by oath (`quranic:root_001623:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:20 `عَهْد` (ع ه د) and `المِيثَاق` (و ث ق); 13:25 `عَهْد` (ع ه د) and `مِيثَاق` (و ث ق).
subchannels.synthesis: Pact, firmness, binding cord, and oath form a contract scene whose force lies in being made tight enough to hold.

subchannels.name: Fulfillment and Maintained Connection
subchannels.scene_or_process: The bound relation is completed, tended repeatedly, and kept continuous rather than abandoned.
subchannels.active_motifs: completion without deficiency and fulfillment of covenant (`quranic:root_001669:B001/m01`); repeated tending of a protected relation (`quranic:root_001055:B001/m01`); maintaining connection against estrangement (`quranic:root_001655:B004/m01`); unbroken continuation of one act after another (`quranic:root_001655:B006/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:20 `يُوفُون` (و ف ي) and `عَهْد` (ع ه د); 13:21 `يَصِلُون`/`يُوصَل` (و ص ل); 13:25 `يُوصَل` (و ص ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Fulfillment is not a single declaration. It consists of tending the bond and repeatedly extending contact so that the relation remains continuous.

subchannels.name: Unfastening, Severance, and Corruption
subchannels.scene_or_process: A finished bond is opened, a social link is cut, and the surrounding order is spoiled.
subchannels.active_motifs: undoing a cord, structure, or pact (`quranic:root_001543:B001/m01`); reopening after prior healing or closure (`quranic:root_001543:B004/m01`); severing kinship and connection (`quranic:root_001240:B007/m01`); departure from sound order (`quranic:root_001154:B001/m01`); expulsion from good and mercy (`quranic:root_001359:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:20, 13:25 `يَنْقُضُون` (ن ق ض); 13:25 `يَقْطَعُون` (ق ط ع), `يُفْسِدُون` (ف س د), and `اللَّعْنَة` (ل ع ن).
subchannels.synthesis: Unfastening, reopening, cutting, corruption, and expulsion form a causal failure sequence. Breach is the first mechanical failure; social and spatial disorder are its outcome.

subchannels.name: Sewn or Unraveled Fabric
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth is assembled by joins and tailoring, or returned to loose material by unravelling.
subchannels.active_motifs: unraveling a woven thing (`quranic:root_001543:B001/m02`); tailoring and fitting cut cloth (`quranic:root_001240:B012/m01`); striped woven garment whose pieces are joined (`quranic:root_001655:B013/m01`); firm construction (`quranic:root_001623:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:20, 13:25 `يَنْقُضُون` (ن ق ض) and `المِيثَاق` (و ث ق); 13:21, 13:25 `يَصِلُون`/`يُوصَل` (و ص ل); 13:25 `يَقْطَعُون` (ق ط ع).
subchannels.synthesis: Tailoring, joining, fastening, and unraveling offer a compact material analogue for covenant. Cutting can help form a fitted garment, but cutting the join returns ordered fabric to separation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A covenant is made firm by binding and maintenance, and destroyed by unfastening, cutting, or internal decay.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:20-21 describe fulfillment and connection, while 13:25 reverses them through breach, cutting, and corruption.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Contractual obligation materializes as cordage, woven fabric, and repaired or ruptured joins.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Inner Core Brought to Rest

subchannels.name: Discernment at the Core
subchannels.scene_or_process: Perception passes beyond blindness to an interior kernel capable of retaining and recognizing truth.
subchannels.active_motifs: purified intellect (`quranic:root_001338:B004/m01`); inner kernel or choicest core (`quranic:root_001338:B003/m01`); knowledge as disclosure to the knower (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); recollection after absence (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); blindness of insight (`quranic:root_001049:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:19 `يَعْلَمُ` (ع ل م), `أَعْمَى` (ع م ي), `يَتَذَكَّرُ` (ذ ك ر), and `الأَلْبَاب` (ل ب ب).
subchannels.synthesis: The scene moves from blocked perception to recollection and finally to the purified inner kernel. The "possessors of cores" image materially distinguishes deep discernment from surface reception.

subchannels.name: Heart Settling After Disturbance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A disturbed interior comes to rest by trusting and repeatedly bringing something to mind.
subchannels.active_motifs: settling after agitation (`quranic:root_003669:B001/m01`); heart or central organ (`quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`); security and trusted calm (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); assent that gives the heart assurance (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); recollection held present (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); assurance in a dependable support (`quranic:root_001623:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:20 `المِيثَاق` (و ث ق); 13:28 `آمَنُوا` (ء م ن), `تَطْمَئِنُّ` (ط م ن), `قُلُوب` (ق ل ب), and `ذِكْر` (ذ ك ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Trust, remembered presence, and the heart's return from disturbance create a calming process. Repetition in 13:28 performs the settling it names.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Discernment penetrates to an inner core, and repeated remembrance settles that interior after disturbance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:19 contrasts knowledge with blindness and addresses people of inner cores, while 13:28 repeats the settling of hearts through remembrance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Kernel, heart, memory, and trust form an interior architecture rather than a generic mental domain.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Kin Gathered Into a Durable Abode

subchannels.name: Lineage and Joined Kin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parents, spouses, descendants, and affiliated kin form a continuing household line.
subchannels.active_motifs: parenthood and nurture (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`); marital spouse (`quranic:root_000652:B002/m01`); kinship through the womb (`quranic:root_000552:B002/m01`); descendants remaining after a person (`quranic:root_001033:B004/m01`); affiliation or attribution to a group (`quranic:root_001655:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:21 `يَصِلُون` (و ص ل); 13:22, 13:24 `عُقْبَى` (ع ق ب); 13:23 `آبَائِهِم` (ء ب و) and `أَزْوَاجِهِم` (ز و ج); 13:30 `الرَّحْمَن` (ر ح م).
subchannels.synthesis: Parenthood, marriage, womb-kinship, descendants, and affiliation construct a household across generations. Entry into the garden preserves relation rather than dissolving it.

subchannels.name: Entry, Gates, and Settled Residence
subchannels.scene_or_process: The household enters a planted enclosure through gates and takes up a stable station in safety.
subchannels.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); entry into an interior (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); gate as entrance (`quranic:root_000163:B001/m01`); home and settled station (`quranic:root_001492:B003/m01`); residence in a place (`quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`); safety and freedom from harm (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:22 `أَقَامُوا` (ق و م); 13:23 `جَنَّات` (ج ن ن), `يَدْخُلُون` (د خ ل), and `بَاب` (ب و ب); 13:24 `سَلَام` (س ل م); 13:27 `أُنْزِلَ` (ن ز ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Garden, entrance, gate, station, and safety make a coherent arrival scene. Peace is the condition of the inhabited interior, not a detached salutation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Related persons are joined, admitted, and settled together in a protected dwelling.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:23-24 gather parents, spouses, and descendants into gardens entered through every gate and greeted with peace.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Lineage and architecture converge through acts of joining and admission.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Provision Allotted, Opened, and Spent

subchannels.name: Allotment and Expenditure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A measured share is given as food or benefit and then released in support of others.
subchannels.active_motifs: apportioned gift or share (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`); food entering and sustaining the body (`quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`); money going out in household or sacred expenditure (`quranic:root_001537:B002/m01`); beneficial action exceeding bare justice (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:22 `رَزَقْنَاهُم` (ر ز ق), `أَنْفَقُوا` (ن ف ق), and `الحَسَنَة` (ح س ن); 13:26 `الرِّزْق` (ر ز ق).
subchannels.synthesis: Allocation supplies both edible sustenance and spendable benefit; expenditure then moves that share outward as enacted good.

subchannels.name: Expansion and Constriction
subchannels.scene_or_process: The same resource is widened for one recipient and narrowed to a small measure for another.
subchannels.active_motifs: expansion, increase, and abundance (`quranic:root_000116:B003/m01`); constriction to a limited quantity (`quranic:root_001205:B004/m01`); apportioned share (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:26 `يَبْسُطُ` (ب س ط), `الرِّزْق` (ر ز ق), and `يَقْدِرُ` (ق د ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Opening and narrowing are opposed operations on one apportioned resource. The scene preserves agency and measure without turning abundance into an intrinsic status of the recipient.

subchannels.name: Temporary Stock and Final Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: Useful goods support a finite interval before the traveler or inhabitant returns to a final place.
subchannels.active_motifs: enjoyed benefit (`quranic:root_001395:B001/m01`); supplies and household goods used to meet a need (`quranic:root_001395:B003/m01`); prolonged enjoyment that remains bounded (`quranic:root_001395:B007/m01`); lower or nearer life (`quranic:root_000493:B002/m01`); later and final condition (`quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`); return to one's destination (`quranic:root_000065:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:26 `الدُّنْيَا` (د ن و), `الآخِرَة` (ء خ ر), and `مَتَاع` (م ت ع); 13:29 `مَآب` (ء و ب).
subchannels.synthesis: Worldly life is a usable stock whose duration can be extended but not made final. The latent travel-goods sense of `متاع` makes return, not possession, the scene's endpoint.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Provision moves through allocation, expansion or restriction, expenditure, and temporary enjoyment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:22 names spending from provision, and 13:26 names the opening and constriction of provision before reducing worldly life to temporary use.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Gift, ration, household expense, and travel stock reveal provision as a circulation system.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Return, Guidance, and Entrusted Reliance

subchannels.name: Recurrent Homeward Turn
subchannels.scene_or_process: One who has departed repeatedly turns back toward a known destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: recurrent return to a place (`quranic:root_001562:B001/m01`); return to a home or destination (`quranic:root_000065:B001/m01`); invitation to turn back in repentance (`quranic:root_000189:B003/m01`); turning and final destination (`quranic:root_001248:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Turning, returning, and arriving at a homeward endpoint make repentance spatial and iterative. The path can be re-entered because return remains an available operation.

subchannels.name: Guided Route Under Trusted Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A guide indicates the road while a trusted guardian receives responsibility for the traveler's affair.
subchannels.active_motifs: gentle guidance to road and truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); delegation of an affair (`quranic:root_001681:B001/m01`); reliance on another (`quranic:root_001681:B002/m01`); custodian sufficient to guard what is entrusted (`quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`); lordship as care and mastery (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:27 `يَهْدِي` (ه د ي) and `رَبّه` (ر ب ب); 13:30 `رَبِّي` (ر ب ب) and `تَوَكَّلْتُ` (و ك ل); 13:31 `هَدَى` (ه د ي).
subchannels.synthesis: Guidance supplies direction; entrustment supplies dependable care. Reliance therefore completes rather than replaces the act of turning toward the destination.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A person turns toward a destination, follows guidance, and entrusts the journey's care to a dependable custodian.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:27 names turning and guidance, while 13:29-30 repeat return and reliance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Repentance becomes recurrent homeward movement, and trust becomes delegated care rather than passivity.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Effective Utterance and Transformed Terrain

subchannels.name: Recitation and Transmission
subchannels.scene_or_process: Revealed information is carried by a messenger and voiced in a following sequence to hearers.
subchannels.active_motifs: reading and recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); a second voice following the first (`quranic:root_000186:B007/m01`); divine message and inspiration (`quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`); messenger and message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); delivery of book or communication downward (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m02`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:30 `أَرْسَلْنَاك` (ر س ل), `لِتَتْلُو` (ت ل و), and `أَوْحَيْنَا` (و ح ي); 13:31 `قُرْآن` (ق ر ء); 13:27 `أُنْزِلَ` (ن ز ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Message, messenger, descent, leading voice, and following voice form a transmission chain. Recitation is the audible continuation of revelation.

subchannels.name: Moving, Cutting, and Addressing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech acts upon resistant terrain and silent bodies as if it were physical agency.
subchannels.active_motifs: compelled movement or travel (`quranic:root_000769:B001/m01`); solid raised mountain mass (`quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`); severing or splitting (`quranic:root_001240:B001/m01`); intelligible speech linking speakers (`quranic:root_001316:B001/m01`); loss of life and force (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); action or making (`quranic:root_000885:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:31 `سُيِّرَت` (س ي ر), `الجِبَال` (ج ب ل), `قُطِّعَت` (ق ط ع), `كُلِّمَ` (ك ل م), `المَوْتَى` (م و ت), and `صَنَعُوا` (ص ن ع).
subchannels.synthesis: Movement, incision, dialogue, death, and making remain separate operations, but all test what an utterance might cause. The scene pressures a merely informational reading of recitation by treating language as world-changing force.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Recited communication is imagined as an operative force capable of moving, cutting, or awakening its object.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:30 names recitation of revelation, and 13:31 imagines a recitation by which mountains move, earth splits, and the dead are addressed.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Voice-following, inscription, movement, incision, and revived dialogue become distinct operations of effective speech.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Promise Approaching the Dwelling

subchannels.name: Appointment and Fulfillment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A spoken promise creates expectation, fixes a time, and is met without failure.
subchannels.active_motifs: promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); appointment fixed by time or place (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); failed promise as contrast (`quranic:root_000433:B005/m01`); arriving at and completing the appointment (`quranic:root_001669:B004/m01`); loss of expectation (`quranic:root_001690:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:20 `يُوفُون` (و ف ي); 13:31 `يَيْأَس` (ي ء س), `يُخْلِف` (خ ل ف), and `وَعْد`/`المِيعَاد` (و ع د).
subchannels.synthesis: Promise, appointed coordinate, arrival, and non-failure form a temporal contract. Despair is the collapsed expectation against which reliable fulfillment is defined.

subchannels.name: Striking Event at the House
subchannels.scene_or_process: A blow-like event reaches a traveled public place, a house yard, or a nearby station and settles there.
subchannels.active_motifs: impact of one thing against another (`quranic:root_001219:B001/m01`); road or house forecourt (`quranic:root_001219:B010/m01`); affliction that reaches a person (`quranic:root_000889:B004/m01`); settling in a place (`quranic:root_000351:B002/m01`); nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`); encircling adversity (`quranic:root_000499:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:31 `قَارِعَة` (ق ر ع), `تُصِيبُهُم` (ص و ب), `تَحُلُّ` (ح ل ل), `قَرِيبًا` (ق ر ب), and `دَارِهِم` (د و ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Impact, forecourt, nearness, settlement, and encirclement make the promised event spatially concrete. It does not remain distant speech; it arrives at the threshold.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A spoken commitment fixes an appointment whose fulfillment arrives as an event at or near a dwelling.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:31 joins God's promise and unbroken appointment to a striking event that reaches or settles near homes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temporal commitment becomes spatial approach and impact.

parent_channels.name: P2 - Controlled Resistance to Harm

subchannels.name: Held Self and Enduring Surety
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person restrains panic, remains with the obligation, and bears responsibility through difficulty.
subchannels.active_motifs: holding the self back from panic (`quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`); surety and continuing responsibility (`quranic:root_000840:B003/m01`); seeking or pursuing an intended end (`quranic:root_000138:B001/m01`); stable beneficial action (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:22 `صَبَرُوا` (ص ب ر), `ابْتِغَاء` (ب غ ي), and `الحَسَنَة` (ح س ن); 13:24 `صَبَرْتُم` (ص ب ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Restraint, continued responsibility, and directed seeking form an active endurance scene. Patience holds both the person and the obligation in place.

subchannels.name: Deflection by Better Conduct
subchannels.scene_or_process: An incoming harm is turned aside through measured, non-colliding response.
subchannels.active_motifs: pushing harm away from one's side (`quranic:root_000466:B001/m01`); protective conciliation instead of collision (`quranic:root_000466:B008/m01`); beneficial or gracious action (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`); badness and injury (`quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:22 `يَدْرَءُون` (د ر ء), `الحَسَنَة` (ح س ن), and `السَّيِّئَة` (س و ء).
subchannels.synthesis: The better act functions as a deflector: it changes the path of harm through controlled engagement. This is a mechanism of redirection, not a broad moral contrast.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Harm is met by holding the self steady and redirecting aggression through a better action.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:22 joins patience to repelling evil with good, and 13:24 names patience as the basis of the final greeting.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Patience becomes restraint and surety, while moral response becomes deflection rather than passive endurance.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Deferred Seizure and Punitive Arrival

subchannels.name: Mockery During Extended Time
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ridicule persists while its perpetrators are allowed a lengthened interval.
subchannels.active_motifs: ridicule and derision (`quranic:root_001587:B001/m01`); extension of time and respite (`quranic:root_001446:B001/m01`); messenger and dispatched mission (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); earlier precedence (`quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`); denial that covers truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:32 `اسْتُهْزِئ` (ه ز ء), `رُسُل` (ر س ل), `قَبْلِك` (ق ب ل), `أَمْلَيْتُ` (م ل و), and `كَفَرُوا` (ك ف ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Mockery and denial occupy a deliberately extended interval. Respite changes the timing of response, not the relation between offense and consequence.

subchannels.name: Seizure After Offense
subchannels.scene_or_process: The offender is called to account, captured, and subjected to a descending affliction.
subchannels.active_motifs: accountability for an offense (`quranic:root_000018:B002/m01`); capture and imprisonment (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); punishment following offense (`quranic:root_001033:B007/m01`); painful chastisement (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); affliction descending upon a group (`quranic:root_001492:B006/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:32 `أَخَذْتُهُم` (ء خ ذ) and `عِقَاب` (ع ق ب); 13:34 `عَذَاب` (ع ذ ب); 13:36-37 `أُنْزِلَ`/`أَنْزَلْنَاه` (ن ز ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Accountability, capture, punishment, and descending affliction form the endpoint of delay. The sequence converts an apparently open interval into a closed penal process.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Opposition is granted temporal room before seizure converts delay into punishment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:32 moves from mockery to respite, seizure, and punishment, and 13:34 names the resulting torment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Respite is a stretched interval whose endpoint is juridical capture.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Supervised Earning and Account

subchannels.name: Standing Custodian Over the Self
subchannels.scene_or_process: A responsible custodian stands over each living self, maintaining and governing its charge.
subchannels.active_motifs: standing care and governance (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); living self or life-principle (`quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`); inward faculty of reason and awareness (`quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`); taking charge of another's affair (`quranic:root_001684:B003/m01`); sufficiency through carrying out an affair (`quranic:root_001310:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Standing, governing, sufficiency, and the living inward self form a custodial scene. Oversight is continuous care over an accountable subject.

subchannels.name: Acquisition Entered Into Reckoning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Each self acquires an outcome, which is known, counted, and returned as consequence.
subchannels.active_motifs: seeking and acquiring benefit (`quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`); causing another to acquire (`quranic:root_001296:B002/m01`); numerical reckoning (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); practical accounting of conduct (`quranic:root_000318:B006/m01`); resulting end of an action (`quranic:root_001033:B006/m01`); knowledge that discloses the act (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:33 `كَسَبَت` (ك س ب) and `يَعْلَم` (ع ل م); 13:40-41 `الحِسَاب` (ح س ب); 13:42 `تَكْسِب` (ك س ب), `يَعْلَم` (ع ل م), and `عُقْبَى` (ع ق ب).
subchannels.synthesis: Acquisition, disclosure, accounting, count, and consequence create a ledger process. What the self "earns" is both an acquired holding and an entry that matures into an outcome.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Each self acts under standing oversight, accumulates consequences, and enters a reckoning.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:33 names one standing over every self by what it earns, 13:40-41 name account, and 13:42 repeats knowledge of every self's earning.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Guardianship and economic acquisition converge in an administered ledger.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Claim, Naming, and Testimony

subchannels.name: Unsupported Naming and Report
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker assigns names, attributes a claim, and offers only outward wording for an absent referent.
subchannels.active_motifs: naming as designation (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`); report conveying information (`quranic:root_001464:B002/m01`); attribution of words that were not said (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); assigning a divine partner (`quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`); outward appearance as opposed to interior (`quranic:root_000970:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:33 `سَمُّوهُم` (س م و), `تُنَبِّئُونَه` (ن ب ء), `شُرَكَاء` (ش ر ك), `ظَاهِر` (ظ ه ر), and `القَوْل` (ق و ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Naming, reporting, attribution, and outward wording form a claim-making scene without evidentiary depth. A label cannot supply the missing referent it purports to identify.

subchannels.name: Witness Grounded in Knowledge and Text
subchannels.scene_or_process: A witness gives a knowledgeable declaration that points to a stable written record.
subchannels.active_motifs: testimony as decisive knowledgeable statement (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`); tongue or utterance that bears witness (`quranic:root_000822:B005/m01`); meaning disclosed by speech or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); knowledge as disclosure (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); written text and ordered letters (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); declaration that something is sufficient (`quranic:root_001310:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:43 `شَهِيدًا` (ش ه د), `بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُم` (ب ي ن), `عِلْم` (ع ل م), `الكِتَاب` (ك ت ب), and `كَفَى` (ك ف ي).
subchannels.synthesis: Witness, articulate declaration, disclosed knowledge, and written record form a complete evidentiary scene. Sufficiency belongs to grounded testimony, not to mere naming.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A claim seeks standing through names and surface speech, but testimony requires disclosed knowledge and a written referent.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:33 demands names for alleged partners and challenges unsupported report, while 13:43 answers denial with witnesses and knowledge of the Book.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Naming and testimony are separated as different evidentiary operations.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Road Opened or Blocked

subchannels.name: Route, Leader, and Beacon
subchannels.scene_or_process: A clear road is marked and entered behind a guide or leading point.
subchannels.active_motifs: extended traversable road (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`); gentle guidance toward road and truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); leader or foremost part that guides (`quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`); clear road across easy ground (`quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`); beacon or waymark (`quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:33 `السَّبِيل` (س ب ل), `هَاد` (ه د ي), and `تُنَبِّئُونَه` (ن ب ء); 13:35 `النَّار` (ن و ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Road, leading figure, easy ground, and beacon make guidance a concrete route scene. The path is legible because its direction is embodied in marks and a forerunner.

subchannels.name: Barrier, Diversion, and Turning Away
subchannels.scene_or_process: A barrier blocks the route, diverts travelers from its line, and turns them away from their destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: obstructing and turning away (`quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`); mountain barrier (`quranic:root_000848:B005/m01`); wandering from the intended route (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); deviation from straightness and resistance to truth (`quranic:root_001052:B001/m01`); turning one's back in withdrawal (`quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Obstruction is more than refusal: a barrier interrupts the road, produces deviation, and ends in withdrawal. The absent guide leaves no leader to restore direction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Orientation depends on a traversable route whose guide and markers can be opposed by barriers and diversion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:33 names obstruction from the path, misguidance, and absence of a guide.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Guidance becomes road engineering: route, leading figure, beacon, barrier, and deviation.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Garden Sustained to Permanence

subchannels.name: Flowing Water, Yield, and Shade
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rivers feed a tree-covered enclosure whose yield and overhead cover remain available.
subchannels.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); flowing current (`quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`); river cut through earth (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`); crop and tree yield (`quranic:root_000043:B002/m01`); sheltering shade (`quranic:root_000966:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:35 `الجَنَّة` (ج ن ن), `تَجْرِي` (ج ر ي), `الأَنْهَار` (ن ه ر), `أُكُلُهَا` (ء ك ل), and `ظِلُّهَا` (ظ ل ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Enclosure, current, channel, yield, and shade create a functioning garden rather than a list of amenities. Continuous supply explains the persistence of both food and cover.

subchannels.name: Lasting Station and Contrasted End
subchannels.scene_or_process: The supplied garden remains fixed as one outcome, while fire forms the opposed outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: duration and stable continuation (`quranic:root_000501:B001/m01`); persistence against removal (`quranic:root_000192:B001/m01`); resulting end (`quranic:root_001033:B006/m01`); promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); burning fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:35 `دَائِم` (د و م), `وُعِد` (و ع د), `عُقْبَى` (ع ق ب), and `النَّار` (ن و ر); 13:39 `يُثْبِت` (ث ب ت).
subchannels.synthesis: Duration, fixedness, promise, and outcome explain why the garden is a station rather than a passing scene. Fire is not another garden component but the terminal contrast that defines the favorable end.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A protected planted enclosure is continuously supplied, yields food, and remains as the favorable end.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:35 joins garden, rivers, lasting produce and shade, and contrasts its outcome with fire.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Irrigation, canopy, duration, and final consequence form one sustained habitat.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Authorized Inscription and Register

subchannels.name: Arabic Text as Binding Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A text is written in an intelligible language, ordered into place, and made legally operative.
subchannels.active_motifs: writing and written document (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); inscription that imposes judgment or decree (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); clarification and intelligible expression (`quranic:root_000996:B001/m01`); adjudication between parties (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`); making a text firm and precise (`quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`); placing a thing in its proper rank (`quranic:root_001492:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:36 `الكِتَاب` (ك ت ب); 13:37 `أَنْزَلْنَاه` (ن ز ل), `حُكْمًا` (ح ك م), and `عَرَبِيًّا` (ع ر ب); 13:38 `كِتَاب` (ك ت ب).
subchannels.synthesis: Writing, intelligibility, ordered placement, legal judgment, and precision form a textual institution. "Arabic" marks communicative disclosure while "judgment" marks operative force.

subchannels.name: Erasure, Establishment, and Master Source
subchannels.scene_or_process: A scribe-like operation removes an inscription or fixes it, while an encompassing source remains present.
subchannels.active_motifs: erasing writing or trace (`quranic:root_001404:B001/m01`); making a thing stable (`quranic:root_000192:B003/m01`); proof or inscription fixed by judgment (`quranic:root_000192:B006/m01`); mother as source and origin (`quranic:root_000053:B001/m01`); written document (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:39 `يَمْحُو` (م ح و), `يُثْبِت` (ث ب ت), `أُمّ` (ء م م), and `الكِتَاب` (ك ت ب).
subchannels.synthesis: Erasure and fixing are opposed scribal operations at the level of trace. The maternal source image prevents alteration from implying loss of origin: the encompassing register remains the matrix from which particular inscriptions derive.

subchannels.name: Term Entered in the Record
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bounded term is written as an enforceable appointment that ends in complete taking of life or account.
subchannels.active_motifs: fixed temporal limit (`quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`); recorded decree (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); appointment fixed by time or place (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); taking a life in full at its term (`quranic:root_001669:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:38 `أَجَل` (ء ج ل) and `كِتَاب` (ك ت ب); 13:40 `نَعِدُهُم` (و ع د) and `نَتَوَفَّيَنَّك` (و ف ي).
subchannels.synthesis: Limit, written decree, appointment, and complete taking form a temporal register. The book gives the term legal stability; fulfillment closes it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Authority gives a text its binding form, permits alteration at one level, and preserves an encompassing register of terms and outcomes.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:37 calls the revelation an Arabic judgment, 13:38 links term and book, and 13:39 names erasure, establishment, and the mother of the Book.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Linguistic clarity, legal force, scribal alteration, and temporal appointment occupy distinct layers of one record system.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Commissioned Messenger and Divided Responsibility

subchannels.name: Permission and Commission
subchannels.scene_or_process: An authority licenses an act, dispatches a messenger, and supplies what is to be brought.
subchannels.active_motifs: permission and licensing (`quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`); binding command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`); messenger and message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); arrival or bringing (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); delivery of a sign or book (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m02`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:36 `أُمِرْت` (ء م ر); 13:38 `رُسُل`/`رَسُول` (ر س ل), `يَأْتِي` (ء ت ي), and `إِذْن` (ء ذ ن); 13:36-37 `أُنْزِلَ`/`أَنْزَلْنَاه` (ن ز ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Command, license, dispatch, arrival, and delivered object form a complete commission. Permission defines the messenger's operating boundary.

subchannels.name: Delivery Versus Account
subchannels.scene_or_process: The messenger conveys the assigned message, while the principal retains demonstration, fulfillment, and reckoning.
subchannels.active_motifs: conveying a message to its endpoint (`quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`); numerical account (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); taking life or term in full (`quranic:root_001669:B002/m01`); causing an event to be seen (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`); promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:40 `نُرِيَنَّك` (ر ء ي), `نَعِدُهُم` (و ع د), `نَتَوَفَّيَنَّك` (و ف ي), `البَلَاغ` (ب ل غ), and `الحِسَاب` (ح س ب).
subchannels.synthesis: Showing, promising, fulfilling the term, delivering, and counting are separate operations. The messenger owns transmission; the commissioning authority owns outcome and reckoning.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A messenger acts under authorization, delivers what is assigned, and does not absorb the authority's work of reckoning.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:38 limits signs to divine permission, and 13:40 divides delivery from account.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Permission, commission, delivery, and reckoning resemble a delegated administrative chain.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Decorated Plot and Concealed Spoilage

subchannels.name: Applied Surface Beauty
subchannels.scene_or_process: A surface is beautified and coated so that its outward appearance commands attention.
subchannels.active_motifs: actively displaying a thing as beautiful (`quranic:root_000660:B002/m01`); ochre pigment used as coating or dye (`quranic:root_001438:B004/m01`); outward appearance and exposure (`quranic:root_000970:B001/m01`); covering a thing from view (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:33 `زُيِّن` (ز ي ن), `مَكْرُهُم` (م ك ر), `ظَاهِر` (ظ ه ر), and `كَفَرُوا` (ك ف ر).
subchannels.synthesis: Beautifying, pigmenting, displaying, and covering make one cosmetic operation: the visible surface is improved precisely by controlling what remains unseen.

subchannels.name: Spoiled Interior and Denial
subchannels.scene_or_process: Beneath the improved surface, food or material decays while the subject refuses recognition.
subchannels.active_motifs: spoiled date or moist fruit (`quranic:root_001438:B006/m01`); consumption turning to bodily or material corruption (`quranic:root_000043:B006/m01`); denial contrary to recognition (`quranic:root_001550:B001/m01`); inward inclination and desire (`quranic:root_001609:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Spoilage, corrosive consumption, denial, and desire supply the hidden state beneath the decorated plot. The channel pressures attractive scheming by exposing it as cosmetic treatment over decay.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An attractive exterior can be applied as a coating while corruption persists beneath it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 13:33 says the plot is made attractive and contrasts it with what is outward in speech.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmetic pigment, covering, and spoiled fruit provide a material anatomy for self-deception.

parent_channels.name: P3 - Contracting Edge and Closed Judgment

subchannels.name: Subtraction From the Margin
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bounded surface loses successive portions beginning at its outer edge.
subchannels.active_motifs: earth as lower ground (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); loss of part or quantity (`quranic:root_001542:B001/m01`); outer edge and endpoint (`quranic:root_000931:B001/m01`); a portion separated from a whole (`quranic:root_000133:B001/m01`); removal of a trace (`quranic:root_001404:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:36, 13:40 `بَعْض` (ب ع ض); 13:39 `يَمْحُو` (م ح و); 13:41 `الأَرْض` (ء ر ض), `نَنْقُصُهَا` (ن ق ص), and `أَطْرَافِهَا` (ط ر ف).
subchannels.synthesis: Surface, edge, separated portion, subtraction, and erasure form a geometric reduction process. The action advances by taking from the boundary rather than by an undifferentiated disappearance.

subchannels.name: Judgment Without Reversal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A judge issues a decision, excludes challenge or return, and moves immediately to account.
subchannels.active_motifs: adjudication between parties (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`); challenge, objection, or attempted reversal (`quranic:root_001033:B008/m01`); speed opposed to delay (`quranic:root_000698:B001/m01`); numerical reckoning (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); evidentiary establishment (`quranic:root_000192:B006/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 13:39 `يُثْبِت` (ث ب ت); 13:41 `يَحْكُم`/`حُكْمِه` (ح ك م), `مُعَقِّب` (ع ق ب), `سَرِيع` (س ر ع), and `الحِسَاب` (ح س ب).
subchannels.synthesis: Judgment, attempted challenge, exclusion of reversal, speed, and account form a closed procedure. The contracting boundary and final ruling jointly remove room for retreat.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A domain is reduced from its margins while an authoritative judgment closes routes of reversal.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 13:41 describes the earth diminished from its edges and a judgment with no reversing party, followed by swift account.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Geometric subtraction and procedural finality become two stages of one enclosing action.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 - Hand-to-Mouth Reach That Fails
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A thirsty person extends open hands toward water but cannot bring it to the mouth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: extending hand and arm (`quranic:root_000116:B004/m01`); palm and fingers (`quranic:root_001308:B001/m01`); reaching an endpoint (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); open mouth (`quranic:root_001190:B001/m01`); water (`quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 13:14 `بَاسِط` (ب س ط), `كَفَّيْه` (ك ف ف), `يَبْلُغ`/`بَالِغِه` (ب ل غ), `المَاء` (م و ه), and `فَاهُ` (ف و ه).
parent_channels.synthesis: Extension, open palm, water, mouth, and failed arrival form a precise bodily scene. Nearness without a workable transfer mechanism materializes the failure of the invoked powers to answer.

parent_channels.name: S2. P1 - Cut and Layered Covering
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A covering is laid over a body in layers, cut to fit, and joined as clothing or armor.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cover laid over a thing (`quranic:root_001088:B001/m01`); night as dark covering (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); under-layer worn beneath garment or armor (`quranic:root_001102:B007/m01`); cloth cut and tailored (`quranic:root_001240:B012/m01`); draping or wrapping in a garment (`quranic:root_001163:B005/m01`); garment or shield worn over the body (`quranic:root_000273:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 13:3 `يُغْشِي` (غ ش و) and `اللَّيْل` (ل ي ل); 13:4 `قِطَع` (ق ط ع) and `نُفَضِّل` (ف ض ل); 13:5 `الأَغْلَال` (غ ل ل); 13:14, 13:18 `يَسْتَجِيبُون`/`اسْتَجَابُوا` (ج و ب).
parent_channels.synthesis: Covering, dark overlay, under-layer, cutting, draping, and outer protection form a compact textile scene. It gives material texture to the interval's repeated operations of covering and enclosure.

parent_channels.name: S3. P3 - Ward and Protector
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A vulnerable person requires a barrier, shield, or ally capable of intercepting harm.
parent_channels.active_motifs: barrier that prevents injury (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); placing oneself in protective restraint (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); supportive ally (`quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`); sufficient guardian (`quranic:root_001310:B001/m01`); shield used for protection (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); protective shade or shelter (`quranic:root_000966:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Barrier, self-protection, ally, sufficient guardian, shield, and shelter form one defense scene. The repeated absence of a ward is therefore the removal of every layer that could intercept harm.

parent_channels.name: S4. P3 - Messenger Household and Continuing Line
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Commissioned messengers live within ordinary family structures that extend into a continuing line.
parent_channels.active_motifs: messenger and dispatched mission (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); marital spouse (`quranic:root_000652:B002/m01`); descendants remaining after a person (`quranic:root_001033:B004/m01`); small seed-like beings spreading outward (`quranic:root_000511:B001/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Mission, marriage, descendants, and dispersed seed form a bounded household-lineage scene. Prophetic commission coexists with embodied succession rather than requiring social isolation.

parent_channels.name: S5. P3 - Worship Without Partnership
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A worshipper directs service and invocation to one deity, rejects co-ownership, and returns to that source.
parent_channels.active_motifs: worship and obedient service (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`); assigning a divine partner (`quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`); vocal invocation drawing the addressee (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); return to a destination (`quranic:root_000065:B001/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 13:33, 13:36 `شُرَكَاء`/`أُشْرِك` (ش ر ك); 13:36 `أَعْبُد` (ع ب د), `أَدْعُو` (د ع و), and `مَآب` (ء و ب).
parent_channels.synthesis: Worship, invocation, rejected partnership, and return form one directed relation. The scene's coherence depends on a single addressee and destination.

parent_channels.name: S6. Whole-Surah - Marked Arrows and Chance Allotment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Players place marked gambling arrows in a leather receptacle, draw a lot, and divide gain or loss according to the result.
parent_channels.active_motifs: leather receptacle gathering gambling arrows (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); fifth marked gambling arrow (`quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`); losing arrow opposed to the winning lot (`quranic:root_000458:B019/m01`); drawing lots among participants (`quranic:root_001219:B004/m01`); gambling victory gained through deception (`quranic:root_001255:B007/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 13:2 `يُدَبِّر` (د ب ر), `القَمَر` (ق م ر), and `رَبّ` (ر ب ب); 13:11 `أَنفُس` (ن ف س); 13:31 `قَارِعَة` (ق ر ع).
parent_channels.synthesis: Receptacle, marked lots, draw, winner, and loser form a complete chance-allotment practice. This reframes the surah's measured decree and exact account by contrast: deceptive play assigns shares contingently, while divine determination is neither random nor manipulable.

parent_channels.name: S7. Whole-Surah - Bow, Target, and Missed Shot
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An archer strings a bow with hard sinew, aims at a practice target, releases, and observes whether the shot holds its line or falls beyond it.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bowstring standing away from the bow's belly (`quranic:root_000170:B008/m01`); hard white sinew used to string bows and arrows (`quranic:root_001033:B001/m01`); leather practice target or hunter's screen (`quranic:root_000466:B005/m01`); directing an arrow toward its intended point (`quranic:root_000053:B012/m01`); arrow passing or falling behind the target (`quranic:root_000458:B018/m01`); shot veering away without scratching its mark (`quranic:root_001464:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: String, target, aim, trajectory, and miss define one archery exercise. This materializes guidance and misguidance as alignment through the whole action: intending a mark does not suffice when the released path bends or overshoots.

parent_channels.name: S8. Whole-Surah - Wrestling Clinch and Throw
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Two standing opponents close into a clinch, one traps the other's legs, and the hold ends by throwing a body to the ground.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wrestler's grasp that confines an opponent (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); leg entanglement used in wrestling (`quranic:root_001036:B010/m01`); standing resistance and bodily contest (`quranic:root_001273:B014/m01`); carrying and casting an opponent onto the ground (`quranic:root_000249:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Stance, grip, leg lock, and fall form a compact wrestling sequence. This materializes compelled submission in 13:15 as loss of bodily resistance: the posture that contests control is progressively bound and brought down.

parent_channels.name: S9. Whole-Surah - Well Hoist and Receiving Hand
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A standing frame carries a pulley and axle over a well; a handled bucket is raised and received by a second worker.
parent_channels.active_motifs: open well before its walls are lined (`quranic:root_001248:B007/m01`); upright support for a well pulley (`quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`); great pulley used to draw water (`quranic:root_001402:B008/m01`); iron axle around which the pulley turns (`quranic:root_000610:B006/m01`); elongated bucket with one handle (`quranic:root_000737:B011/m01`); worker receiving the raised bucket from the drawer (`quranic:root_001198:B007/m02`).

parent_channels.name: S17. Whole-Surah - Suppurating Wound and Discharge

parent_channels.name: S20. P1-P2-P3 Cross-Pericope Bridge - Signs Are Displayed, Demanded, and Permission-Gated
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (13:1-18) remains canonical at "Articulation That Separates Meaning"; P2 (13:19-31) remains canonical at "Effective Utterance and Transformed Terrain"; P3 (13:32-43) remains canonical at "Commissioned Messenger and Divided Responsibility". Bridge (evidentiary role progression and authorization contrast): displayed signs become a demanded token, then the demand meets the messenger's permission boundary.

Their bridge is a change in the sign's discourse role: P1 presents signs already differentiated and available, P2 turns the sign into an objection's demanded object, and P3 locates any sign-bearing act inside delegated authority. The progression pressures the demand itself, since evidentiary availability does not grant the recipient control over the form or timing of demonstration.

parent_channels.name: S21. P1-P2-P3 Cross-Pericope Bridge - The Guided Route Is Entered or Obstructed
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (13:1-18) remains canonical at "Seeing and Wayfinding"; P2 (13:19-31) remains canonical at "Return, Guidance, and Entrusted Reliance"; P3 (13:32-43) remains canonical at "Road Opened or Blocked". Bridge (repeated route signature, role progression, and reversal): a guide discloses the route, a returning traveler re-enters it, and obstruction diverts the traveler until no guide remains.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: gentle guidance toward road and truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); recurrent return toward a destination (`quranic:root_001562:B001/m01`); extended traversable road (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`); obstruction and turning away (`quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`); deviation from guidance and intended direction (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`).
