parent_channels.synthesis: The local perception, return, and road scenes retain their canonical placements. The bridge assigns each pericope a successive route role: P1 makes orientation legible, P2 supplies the traveler's homeward turn, and P3 supplies the counter-operation that blocks and bends the path. Misguidance is therefore not a second destination but the reversal of a disclosed and still traversable route.

parent_channels.name: S22. P1-P2-P3 Cross-Pericope Bridge - Appointment Moves from Course to Promise to Record
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (13:1-18) remains canonical at "Celestial Course and Appointment"; P2 (13:19-31) remains canonical at "Promise Approaching the Dwelling"; P3 (13:32-43) remains canonical at "Term Entered in the Record". Bridge (shared scheduled-arrival invariant and causal progression): a moving body approaches a fixed limit, a promise converts that limit into an expected arrival, and a written term closes in complete fulfillment.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: fixed temporal limit (`quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`); promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); appointment fixed by time or place (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); attendance that completes an appointment (`quranic:root_001669:B004/m01`); recorded and enforceable decree (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); complete taking of life at its term (`quranic:root_001669:B002/m01`).

parent_channels.synthesis: The local course, threshold-arrival, and register scenes retain their canonical placements. Their bridge is not time in general but the same scheduled-arrival structure under increasing closure: motion tends toward a limit, speech fixes expectation around it, and inscription makes the term enforceable until complete taking fulfills it. Delay can lengthen approach, but it cannot dissolve the appointment.

parent_channels.name: S23. P1-P2-P3 Cross-Pericope Bridge - Garden Progresses from Plot to Abode to End
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (13:1-18) remains canonical at "Irrigated Plot and Differentiated Yield"; P2 (13:19-31) remains canonical at "Kin Gathered Into a Durable Abode"; P3 (13:32-43) remains canonical at "Garden Sustained to Permanence". Bridge (repeated scene signature and role progression): the planted enclosure first functions as cultivated evidence, then as an entered household dwelling, and finally as the enduring promised outcome.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); crop and tree yield (`quranic:root_000043:B002/m01`); flowing river channel (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`); entry into an interior (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); home or settled station (`quranic:root_001492:B003/m01`); stable duration (`quranic:root_000501:B001/m01`).

parent_channels.synthesis: The local agricultural, household-entry, and permanent-habitat scenes retain their canonical placements. Their bridge is the repeated garden signature under a change of role: P1 displays productive order, P2 admits related persons into that order as residents, and P3 fixes the supplied enclosure as an outcome. Created fertility thus becomes inhabitable promise without collapsing plot, household, and final station into one local scene.

parent_channels.name: S24. P1-P2-P3 Cross-Pericope Bridge - Earth Is Extended, Cut, and Diminished
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (13:1-18) remains canonical at "Water Gathered, Routed, and Made Fruitful"; P2 (13:19-31) remains canonical at "Moving, Cutting, and Addressing"; P3 (13:32-43) remains canonical at "Subtraction From the Margin". The sequence gives final judgment a spatial pressure already prepared by the surah's opening act of spreading.

parent_channels.name: S25. P1-P2-P3 Cross-Pericope Bridge - What Follows Becomes Irreversible
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (13:1-18) remains canonical at "Sovereign Custody and Alignment" and "Storm Force Announced and Delivered"; P2 (13:19-31) remains canonical at "Controlled Resistance to Harm"; P3 (13:32-43) remains canonical at "Deferred Seizure and Punitive Arrival" and "Contracting Edge and Closed Judgment". Bridge (same-root causal sequence and role reversal): protective successors first follow a subject, conduct then produces an after-condition, punishment follows offense, and finally no following challenger can reverse judgment.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: one thing succeeding another in alternation (`quranic:root_001033:B005/m01`); resulting end or after-effect of action (`quranic:root_001033:B006/m01`); punishment following offense (`quranic:root_001033:B007/m01`); subsequent challenge, objection, or attempted reversal (`quranic:root_001033:B008/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The custody, conduct, punishment, and judgment scenes retain their canonical placements. Their bridge is the exact `ع ق ب` relation of something coming after: alternation can preserve a charge in P1, morally directed action can yield a favorable after-condition in P2, and offense can mature into punishment in P3. The closing reversal removes the last possible successor role, because no later challenger can follow the judgment and reopen it.

parent_channels.name: S26. P1-P2 Cross-Pericope Bridge - Targeted Strike Reaches the Dwelling
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (13:1-18) remains canonical at "Storm Force Announced and Delivered"; P2 (13:19-31) remains canonical at "Promise Approaching the Dwelling". Bridge (repeated impact signature and causal role progression): atmospheric force acquires a target, then the same reaching operation becomes an affliction arriving at or near a household.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: aiming at and reaching an intended target (`quranic:root_000889:B003/m01`); affliction that reaches and takes a person (`quranic:root_000889:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The local storm-discharge and threshold-arrival scenes retain their canonical placements. Their bridge is the repeated target-impact signature: P1 establishes directed force rather than random atmospheric release, and P2 transfers that trajectory to a calamity entering human space. The later dwelling scene therefore materializes the earlier menace as an event that has completed its approach.

parent_channels.name: S27. P2-P3 Cross-Pericope Bridge - Joy Changes with Its Object
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P2 (13:19-31) remains canonical at "Temporary Stock and Final Return"; P3 (13:32-43) remains canonical at "Arabic Text as Binding Judgment". Bridge (contrast and object reversal): the same receptive joy attaches first to bounded worldly stock and then to descending revelation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: joy as expansion of the interior (`quranic:root_001140:B001/m01`); joy becoming blameworthy exultation (`quranic:root_001140:B002/m01`); enjoyed but bounded benefit (`quranic:root_001395:B001/m01`); delivered book or revelation (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m02`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 13:26 `فَرِحُوا` (ف ر ح) and `مَتَاع` (م ت ع); 13:36 `يَفْرَحُون` (ف ر ح) and `أُنْزِلَ` (ن ز ل).
parent_channels.synthesis: The local temporary-provision and binding-text scenes retain their canonical placements. The bridge does not treat joy as a generic theme; it tests the affect by its received object. P2's joy risks closing around stock whose use and duration are finite, whereas P3's joy opens toward revelation whose authority exceeds the recipient, reversing self-satisfied possession into receptive recognition.

parent_channels.name: S28. P1-P2-P3 Cross-Pericope Bridge - Account Moves from Liability to Foresight to Execution
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (13:1-18) remains canonical at "Ransom, Refuge, and Assigned Bed"; P2 (13:19-31) remains canonical at "Covenant as Tensioned Binding" and "Controlled Resistance to Harm"; P3 (13:32-43) remains canonical at "Supervised Earning and Account" and "Judgment Without Reversal". Bridge (causal sequence and accounting-role progression): a bad account first establishes liability, anticipation of that account shapes conduct before settlement, and the authority who retains the count executes it without delay.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: numerical reckoning and account (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); practical accounting of conduct (`quranic:root_000318:B006/m01`); fear that anticipates a harmful outcome (`quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`); speed opposed to delay (`quranic:root_000698:B001/m01`).

parent_channels.synthesis: The local failed-release, covenantal-conduct, ledger, and closed-judgment scenes retain their canonical placements. Their bridge is procedural: P1 shows account as a liability no substitute can discharge, P2 moves it forward into disciplined foresight, and P3 assigns delivery and counting to different roles before making the retained account swift. The invariant is who holds the reckoning and when it becomes operative, rather than consequence in general.

parent_channels.name: S29. Whole-Surah - Oath Formula, Binding, and Release
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A speaker opens an oath, invokes God's name, binds a declaration by swearing, and performs the recognized act that releases the oath.

parent_channels.synthesis: Invocation, formula, sworn bond, and formal release form one speech rite. This materializes the surah's covenant reading by showing that words can create an obligation and that undoing it requires a recognized counter-operation, sharpening the contrast with those who break God's covenant after binding it.

parent_channels.name: S30. Whole-Surah - Wound Assessment and Blood-Money Settlement
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A bodily wound is assigned a mandatory valuation, retaliation is commuted to blood money, a surety assumes the liability, and the indemnity is paid.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bodily wound (`quranic:root_001316:B003/m01`); wound carrying an assessed obligation (`quranic:root_001488:B003/m01`); blood money replacing retaliation (`quranic:root_001036:B004/m01`); substitute indemnity (`quranic:root_001119:B002/m01`); collective carriage of liability (`quranic:root_000357:B004/m01`); written or personal guarantee (`quranic:root_001198:B008/m01`); payment of blood money (`quranic:root_001637:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Injury, valuation, substitution, guarantee, and payment form a complete indemnity procedure. It materializes bad account as an exact liability that can pass to a competent carrier only within an accepted settlement order; by contrast, 13:18 denies that ultimate liability can be discharged by an offered ransom.

parent_channels.name: S31. Whole-Surah - Stipulated Work and Earned Wage
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Parties stipulate a defined task and wage, the worker performs the task, and the agreed provision is paid, with compelled unpaid labor as the reversal.
parent_channels.active_motifs: contract for a fixed work and wage (`quranic:root_001240:B024/m01`); reward assigned to a task (`quranic:root_000248:B005/m01`); worker's wage or provision (`quranic:root_001046:B004/m01`); labor compelled without pay (`quranic:root_000685:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Stipulation, task, wage, and payment form one labor relation, while corvee supplies its exact role reversal. The scene supports supervised earning and allotted provision by separating accountable work with a fixed return from service imposed without reciprocal settlement.

parent_channels.name: S32. Whole-Surah - Written Installments for Manumission
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An enslaved person enters a written, installment-based route to freedom, while a second legal form defers release until the owner's death.
parent_channels.active_motifs: reduction of a person to compulsory service (`quranic:root_000973:B004/m01`); written manumission contract with scheduled payments (`quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`); freedom conditioned on the owner's death (`quranic:root_000458:B007/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Servile status, inscribed terms, staged payment, and condition-triggered release form a bounded legal frame. It materializes 13:38's relation between a term and a book: writing does not merely describe status but specifies when its reversal becomes operative, pressing the surah's larger contrast between recorded obligation and failed self-ransom.

parent_channels.name: S33. Whole-Surah - Pot Fire, Removal, and Emptying
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Meat changes under fire inside a cooking pot; a cloth protects the hand as the hot vessel is removed, then the pot is tilted and emptied.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cooking pot and its prepared contents (`quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`); meat altered until its juices run (`quranic:root_001266:B002/m01`); heat-protective cloth for removing the pot (`quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`); tipping and pouring out the vessel (`quranic:root_000249:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Vessel, fire-transformed food, protective handling, and emptying make one cooking sequence. This usefully pressures the fire assay of 13:17: controlled heat can produce nourishment rather than dross, so benefit depends not on exposure to force alone but on the material, operation, and resulting transformation.

parent_channels.name: S34. Whole-Surah - Mixed Camel Ration at the Watering Place
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Date stones are mixed into fodder, flour or seed extends the animals' water into a ration, and the mixture is delivered at the camels' mouths while they drink.
parent_channels.active_motifs: date stones mixed with camel fodder (`quranic:root_001102:B010/m01`); water compounded with flour, seed, or sesame (`quranic:root_001407:B008/m01`); watering directly at the camels' mouths (`quranic:root_001198:B014/m01`); animal mouth engaged in eating and drinking (`quranic:root_001190:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Dry feed, liquid admixture, mouth-level delivery, and consumption form a complete husbandry practice. It materializes routed provision and reframes the differentiated food of 13:4: one water can become a deliberately compounded ration through what is added and how it reaches the creature that consumes it.

parent_channels.name: S35. Whole-Surah - Layered Saddle and Secured Load
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A camel's girth is spread and fastened, layered pads are placed around the hump and beneath the saddle, and the secured mount receives rider or baggage.
parent_channels.active_motifs: camel girth spread and tightened (`quranic:root_000467:B006/m02`); under-saddle layer protecting the back (`quranic:root_001684:B011/m01`); riding cloth or pad fitted around the hump (`quranic:root_000766:B010/m01`); cut-piece pad beneath the saddle (`quranic:root_001240:B015/m02`); mount and gear carrying a load (`quranic:root_000970:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Girth, successive underlayers, fitted saddle, and load form one transport mechanism. The assembly materializes both guided travel and covenant as tensioned binding: distinct parts carry a burden only while their placement and fastening preserve alignment, whereas loosening the bond turns support into injury and failed passage.

parent_channels.name: S36. Whole-Surah - Racing Gait and Second Place
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A fit horse moves through a controlled racing gait, and the field settles into an order in which the second horse follows closely behind the leader.
parent_channels.active_motifs: controlled racing gait (`quranic:root_001212:B014/m01`); fit horse whose strides register in line (`quranic:root_000347:B014/m01`); second horse following the leader (`quranic:root_000879:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 13:2 `يَجْرِي` and the scheduled celestial course; 13:19 `الحَقّ` (ح ق ق); 13:22 `الصَّلَاة` (ص ل و); and 13:31 `قَرِيبًا` (ق ر ب).
parent_channels.synthesis: Regulated gait, aligned stride, and following position form a compact race scene. It materializes the surah's scheduled-course reading through bodies whose line and pace determine order, while second place usefully contrasts with celestial motion directed to an appointed term rather than a rank won by overtaking.

parent_channels.name: S37. Whole-Surah - Lunar Stations, Fullness, and Concealment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The moon takes a different station night by night, passes a named three-star mansion, reaches its even or full phase, and then disappears at the month's end.
parent_channels.active_motifs: moon entering successive nightly stations (`quranic:root_000018:B008/m01`); three-star lunar mansion (`quranic:root_001096:B006/m01`); night of the moon's even fullness (`quranic:root_000766:B012/m01`); crescent concealed at the close of the month (`quranic:root_000697:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 13:2 `القَمَر`, `يَجْرِي`, and `لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى`; 13:6 `مَغْفِرَة` (غ ف ر); 13:10 `سَوَاء` and `أَسَرَّ` (س و ي, س ر ر); and 13:16, 13:32 `اتَّخَذْتُم`/`أَخَذْتُهُم` (ء خ ذ).
parent_channels.synthesis: Nightly position, named station, fullness, and disappearance form one observable calendar cycle. The scene directly materializes 13:2's scheduled lunar course: concealment is a phase within measured recurrence, not cessation, and therefore also pressures the assumption that what passes from sight has escaped the governing term.

parent_channels.name: S38. Whole-Surah - Aromatic Ingredients, Powder, and Applied Perfume
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Aromatic ingredients including camphor and powder are compounded into perfume or khaluq and applied to a person or clothing.
parent_channels.active_motifs: aromatic ingredients used in perfume (`quranic:root_001190:B005/m01`); camphor fragrance (`quranic:root_001307:B011/m01`); powdered aromatic (`quranic:root_000511:B003/m01`); perfume as a pleasant substance (`quranic:root_000961:B007/m01`); khaluq and its application as a coating (`quranic:root_000434:B010/m01`); perfume applied to women or clothing (`quranic:root_000058:B007/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Ingredient, fragrant material, powder, compound, coating, and recipient form one perfume practice. It gives sensory force to `طُوبَى` as pleasantness while usefully pressuring decorated appearance in 13:33: an applied fragrance can alter reception without changing the substrate, so a pleasing surface is not by itself the surah's good final outcome.

parent_channels.name: S39. Whole-Surah - Burrow With a Visible Entrance and Hidden Exit
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A small animal descends into a dug burrow, projects its neck at an opening, and uses a through-tunnel whose displayed entrance conceals another way out.
parent_channels.active_motifs: descending burrow and entry into it (`quranic:root_000691:B002/m01`); traversable underground tunnel with an exit (`quranic:root_001537:B003/m01`); jerboa or hare inserting its neck at the burrow (`quranic:root_001053:B007/m02`); displayed entrance paired with a concealed departure (`quranic:root_001537:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 13:5 `أَعْنَاق` (ع ن ق); 13:10 `مُسْتَخْفٍ` and `سَارِب` (س ر ب); and 13:22 `أَنفَقُوا` (ن ف ق).
parent_channels.synthesis: Descent, opening, projected body, through-passage, and concealed exit form one burrow scene. It reframes 13:10's secret and public movement: a route can be engineered to show one access point while hiding another, but tactical concealment does not divide the knower of the hidden from the knower of the visible.

parent_channels.name: S40. Whole-Surah - Convalescence Followed by Relapse
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Bodily corruption intensifies into an illness that confines movement, appears to improve, and then returns in a worse state.
parent_channels.active_motifs: corruption of stomach, body, or organ (`quranic:root_000996:B008/m01`); illness becoming severe (`quranic:root_000151:B008/m01`); sickness immobilizing the patient (`quranic:root_000192:B004/m01`); convalescence and restored health (`quranic:root_001397:B012/m01`); relapse after improvement (`quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 13:6 `مَغْفِرَة` and `المَثُلَات` (غ ف ر, م ث ل); 13:14 `يَبْلُغ`/`بَالِغِه` and 13:40 `البَلَاغ` (ب ل غ); 13:17 `الأَمْثَال`, 13:18 `مِثْلَه`, and 13:35 `مَثَل` (م ث ل); 13:37 `عَرَبِيًّا` (ع ر ب); and 13:39 `يُثْبِت` (ث ب ت).
parent_channels.synthesis: Interior corruption, intensification, confinement, apparent recovery, and relapse form one disease course distinct from the suppurating-wound scene. It usefully pressures the surah's readings of inward change and establishment: visible improvement can reverse when the underlying condition persists, unlike the durable settling of the heart and the finality of what is established in the record.
